moat.title: Strengths (RHP)
moat.body:
- distribution: International network of strategically located offices across key markets — evidence: chairman's message describes 'continued strengthening of our presence through strategically located offices in key markets' bringing the Company closer to customers and operating partners.
- integration: Complementary subsidiary capabilities widen the services offered to a single customer — evidence: chairman's message states 'the complementary capabilities of our subsidiaries enable us to address a wider set of customer requirements and participate across more parts of the logistics value chain.'

- Natural disasters, pandemics, cyber incidents, port closures and other unforeseen events may interrupt operations.
